title: WOEST-3
official: What is the optimal antithrombotic strategy in patients with atrial fibrillation having acute coronary syndrome or undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention?
summary:
Main objective: 1. To assess bleeding risk (i.e. safety) with 30-day DAPT compared to standard therapy at 6 weeks after successful PCI in patients with AF.
2. To assess ischemic risk (i.e. efficacy) with 30-day DAPT compared to standard therapy at 6 weeks after successful PCI in patients with AF.
conditions:
Atrial fibrillation
Acute coronary syndrome
Chronic coronary syndrome

interventions.name: TICAGRELOR MICRO LABS 90 mg, comprimé pelliculé

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. ≥18 years of age
2. Undergoing successful PCI
3. History of or newly diagnosed (<72 hours after PCI/ACS) atrial fibrillation or flutter with a long-term (≥ 1 year) indication for OAC
Exclusion criteria:
1. Contra indication to edoxaban, aspirin or all P2Y12 inhibitors (e.g. kidney failure (eGFR <15) or allergy)
2. Life expectancy <1 year
3. Other oral anticoagulation than NOAC or acenocoumarol at randomization (e.g. fenprocoumon)
4. Active malignancy with metastases or non-curative treatment (e.g. palliative chemotherapy)
5. Known coagulopathy
6. Active bleeding on randomization
7. History of intraocular, spinal, retroperitoneal, or traumatic intra-articular bleeding, unless the causative factor has been permanently resolved
8. Recent (<1 month) gastrointestinal haemorrhage, unless the causative factor has been permanently resolved.
9. Severe anaemia requiring blood transfusion or thrombocytopenia <50 × 10^9/L
10. Pregnancy or breast-feeding women
11. BMI >40 or bariatric surgery
12. Poor LV function (LVEF <30%) with proven slow-flow
13. <12 months after any stroke
14. CHA2DS2VASc score ≥7
15. Current indication for OAC besides atrial fibrillation/flutter (e.g. venous thromboembolism, mechanical heart valve prosthesis, intracardiac thrombus or apical aneurysm requiring OAC)
16. History of intracranial haemorrhage
17. Moderate to severe mitral valve stenosis (AVA ≤1.5 cm2)
18. Active liver disease (ALT, ASP, AP >3x ULN or active hepatitis A, B or C)
